Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP + target close / procurement signature window

Hi Sophie — great to connect this morning. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery so we’re all aligned on the path to production and contracting. I’ve attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP_v0.3) and the commercial termsheet for reference.

Summary (high level)
- Target close (go-live contract effective date): 2026-09-30 (proposed)
- Procurement signature deadline (your side): 2026-09-15 (target)
- Primary milestones:
  1) Legal review & comments — NovusAI (Sophie / Legal) — due 2026-09-01
  2) Procurement review and PO request — NovusAI Procurement — due 2026-09-10
  3) Redwood redlines + final terms — Redwood Legal (Laura) — due 2026-09-12
  4) Signature & countersignature — target 2026-09-15 to 2026-09-30
- Dependencies:
  - SOC2 evidence and data residency appendix (NovusAI needs confirmation)
  - Procurement PO approval cadence (you mentioned finance window every other week)
  - Network allowlist + IP range confirmation for Dedicated (if required)

Asks / proposed owners
- Sophie: Confirm the procurement deadline is realistic for your finance team and add the procurement contact on reply.
- Procurement: Confirm whether 2026-09-15 is an achievable signature cutoff or whether we should plan for a later countersign date.
- Laura (cc): Standby for legal redlines; we’ll aim to keep changes scoped to the commercial term sheet.

If the procurement deadline is tighter than 9/15, we can consider a short commercial acceptance buffer (e.g., staged billing) or escalate to Sales Ops for an accelerated contracting path.

Attachments:
- MAP_v0.3.xlsx (draft milestones & owners)
- Commercial_Termsheet_Novus_v2.pdf (current pricing & SLA)

Thanks again — I’ll wait to hear procurement availability and any date constraints so I can update the MAP and circulate a revised version.

Best,

Jonas / Laura — quick internal sync before we reply to Novus:

Notes from a solutioning standpoint:
- Data residency: for Dedicated we can offer EU-hosted KV/cache and US-hosted embeddings; need to confirm which Novus needs. Adding a short appendix in the MAP that states "final residency to be confirmed prior to SOW" should unblock procurement.
- SOC2 artifacts: procurement often asks for the specific control evidence. I recommend we attach the SOC2 summary and offer a short live call with our security PM to close any gaps.
- If procurement pushes the signature to 9/20+, suggest we propose a limited-activation pathway: sign Master Services Agreement by 9/20 and schedule a technical acceptance milestone after signature (30 days). That keeps revenue timing flexible and reduces procurement friction.

Commercial ask:
- We may need to offer a modest one-time onboarding credit if Novus insists on a later signature beyond 9/20. Suggest ~5% of first-month committed spend — happy to have Laura weigh in.

Laura — can you prepare a pared-down redline response that preserves the commercial term sheet so we don’t re-open pricing? Also, I can offer a short security call with Novus this week; should I propose Thurs/Fri?

—Karthik
